title: Leading Edge Harnesses — Slat and Flap Position Sensing Group
abstract: Wiring sheet for the leading edge harness group carrying slat and flap position sensing, showing the runs that pass behind the access panels and the flap track fairing disconnects.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the leading edge harness group carrying slat and flap position sensing, together with the disconnects at the flap track fairings and the access panel pass-throughs.
sections.sheet_note: The runs behind the fixed leading edge access panels are the ones most often disturbed, because the panels are opened at every slat inspection. The sheet gives the clip positions relative to the panel land rather than to the rib, so that a run can be checked with the panel off and nothing else disassembled. The flap track fairing disconnects are shown per fairing; on the twin-lug fairing standard the disconnect moves eighty millimetres inboard and the sheet carries both positions with effectivity.
sections.routing_note: The group runs along the fixed leading edge behind the access panels, drops at each slat position and continues outboard to the wing tip. The flap position sensing branch leaves at the rear spar and runs aft to the flap track fairings, disconnecting at each fairing so that a fairing can be removed without breaking the main run. Every pass-through at an access panel land carries an edging grommet; a run refitted without one will chafe within a season.
